title: Whimsical Gold Multicolour Crystal Wreath Studs
storyHtml:
An open gold wreath set with a confetti of coloured cabochons — red, green, yellow, pink. Joyful, eclectic, impossible to be sad in.

Jewelry that marks your every becoming.
